M34 — 2026-10-19
A sofar drive --detach driver, and each session it launches, leads its own process group, so killTracked and a gate's group kill never reach them. Tests that start one must call reapMatching([bundle, ...roots]) from test/helpers/reap.ts in afterAll; STUB_LINGER sessions end after STUB_LINGER_MS (default 120 s).
